drift-stream.description: Drift Stream is a native Android client for Stremio addons, built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. It has its own interface, a built-in torrent streaming engine and a libVLC player. It ships no content and no stream addon (only Cinemeta for catalogs and metadata), so you add your own. It also has a library, downloads, theming and a family mode, with no ads, analytics or accounts.
